crossRefs.note: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

people.name: Eleasah
people.line: Descendant of Saul and Jonathan, son of Rapha

people.name: Eliphelet
people.line: A descendant of King Saul from the tribe of Benjamin.

people.name: Jeush
people.line: A descendant of Eleasah from the tribe of Benjamin

people.name: Ulam
people.line: Descendant of Benjamin, known for his numerous descendants

translations.web: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
translations.bsb: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
translations.asv: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
